$comment: CURRENT STATE of the ADR efforts, never their history: the hubs under docs/adr-<n>/ carry the narrative, this file is only their structured extract. It feeds the digest injected at every Claude Code session start (.claude/settings.json → `node .ci/scripts/adr-state.mts --digest`). Schema checked in CI (`--check`): status ∈ proposed | accepted | active | closed | abandoned; nextAction = ONE imperative action ≤ 300 chars, never what was just done; blockers ≤ 4 × 200 chars; openPoints ≤ 6 × 200 chars, no ✅ entry (what is done leaves this file); whole file ≤ 8 KB. Replace fields, never append a report to them. Public repository: nothing private here (client projects, private plugins). Detail: adr skill.
